questions.q: Fixed costs are $6,000. Price is $10 and variable cost is $4 per unit. What is the break-even output?
Which is a fixed cost for a bakery?
questions.why: Rent does not change with output; the others rise with each loaf produced.

questions.q: Break-even output is 1,000 units and the business sells 1,400 units. What is the margin of safety?
questions.why: Margin of safety = actual output − break-even output = 1,400 − 1,000.

questions.q: Explain one limitation of break-even analysis.
questions.model: It assumes all output is sold, but in reality some products may be unsold, so the break-even point may not be accurate. (Or: costs and prices change, so the break-even point changes.)
points: valid limitation (all output sold / costs or prices change / fixed costs may change)
why it makes the result inaccurate
